Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions and answers
Faq.description: All you need to know about licensing, delivery, and payment options for our digital products and services.

card.title: Still have questions?
card.description: Talk to our team on WhatsApp or by email and we’ll help you pick the right solution.

sourceCode.question: Do I receive the full source code?
sourceCode.answer: Yes, for products sold with source code. You receive the files, your license key and setup notes by email right after payment.

delivery.question: How are licenses and downloads delivered?
delivery.answer: Everything is sent to your inbox right after payment: your license keys, download links and a ZATCA-compliant invoice. If anything doesn’t arrive, our team will resend it.

payment.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: You can pay with mada, Apple Pay, Visa or Mastercard, or split the cost with Tabby. All payments are processed through a secure checkout.

customize.question: Can you customize a product for my business?
customize.answer: Yes. Tell us about your business goals and technical requirements, and our team will review them and send you a fixed quote in SAR, scoped to your needs.

zatca.question: Are your invoices ZATCA-compliant?
zatca.answer: Yes. Every invoice we issue follows ZATCA requirements, and we also offer ZATCA Phase 2 and Fatoora integration for your own systems.

refund.question: What is your refund policy?
refund.answer: Because digital products are delivered instantly, refunds are reviewed case by case. If something doesn’t work as described, contact our team and we’ll fix it or arrange a refund where it applies.
